guarantees.claim: digest_size is determined by digest_size_supplied: if digest_size_supplied is SHA2_256, SHA2_384, or SHA2_512, digest_size equals the same; for all other values, digest_size is set to SHA2_None.

assumptions.claim: External logic must interpret digest_size == SHA2_None as an invalid configuration and either block HMAC/SHA-2 start or signal an error to software, as indicated by the comment.
assumptions.risk: If external logic ignores SHA2_None and starts operation, an unsupported digest size may be used, leading to incorrect hash computation or security bypass.

uncertain_points.claim: The comment implies that unsupported digest size is blocked and error is signalled, but this always_comb block only maps to SHA2_None. The critical blocking/error logic is not shown here; it must be verified in other parts of the design.
uncertain_points.cond: when digest_size_supplied takes an unsupported value
uncertain_points.risk: If the blocking/error logic is missing or misconnected, the HMAC/SHA-2 engine may operate with an unsupported digest size, potentially compromising integrity or security.
